exposure: Birth weight (appropriate for gestational age vs. not)
Gestational age at birth (term vs. preterm)
Degree of gross motor function and fine motor disorders
Mental retardation or psycho-social developmental delay
cohort: 234 children aged between 3 and 18 years with cerebral palsy
finding: Family history of epilepsy, history of neonatal seizure, quadriplegic type of CP, severe motor disorders, and moderate to severe mental retardation were identified as risk factors for epilepsy in children with cerebral palsy.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not a significant risk factor for the development of epilepsy in children with cerebral palsy.
